source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (cybersecurity OR "cyber security") AND (policy OR governance OR "human factors" OR behaviour OR behavior OR society)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(cybersecurity OR "cyber security") AND (policy OR governance OR "human factors" OR behaviour OR behavior OR society),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("cyber security" OR "cybersecurity") AND ("human factors" OR "behavior" OR "behaviour" OR "governance" OR "policy" OR "society"))
